up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for CYP3A4, including the substrate structure, substrate and parent compound names, metabolic conversion, pathway, and organism.
sql: WITH target AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 3A4'), metabolism_data AS (SELECT m.met_id, m.drug_record_id, m.substrate_record_id, m.met_conversion, m.organism, m.pathway_key FROM metabolism m JOIN target ON m.enzyme_tid = target.tid WHERE m.enzyme_tid IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200) SELECT md.met_id, s.canonical_smiles, sub.compound_name AS substrate_name, p.compound_name AS parent_compound_name, md.met_conversion, md.pathway_key, md.organism FROM metabolism_data md LEFT JOIN compound_records sub ON md.substrate_record_id = sub.record_id LEFT JOIN compound_structures s ON sub.molregno = s.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records p ON md.drug_record_id = p.record_id ORDER BY md.met_id
